svg.title: FIG-03 当前配置与原子生成：仅构建期数据流 FIG-03 Current configuration and generation: build-time data flow only
svg.desc: 一份 authored TOML One authored TOML assembly; package.json 事实、binding_files 与构建入口 package.json Facts, binding_files and build entry; SoC／CPU／route／审核资料 SoC / CPU / routes / review facts; Board 接线与电气授权 Board wiring and electrical authorization; 严格字段检查 冻结 AuthoredAssembly Strict field checks Frozen AuthoredAssembly; 所选输入：同一受控快照 字节身份与发布前复核 One controlled snapshot of selected inputs Byte identities and pre-publication recheck; 通用 DataProvider／领域与 IP 政策 BindingPolicy 与私有 schema Generic DataProvider / domain and IP policies BindingPolicy and private schemas; 通用解析与资源决策 模式、引用、冲突、预算 Generic resolution and resource decisions Modes, references, conflicts, budgets; 不可变具名 IR 共享 canonical 引用 Immutable named IR Shared canonical references; 有限静态装配 对象、引用、固定调用与薄 IRQ Bounded static assembly Objects, references, fixed calls and thin IRQ entries; 事务生成与原子发布 Transactional generation and atomic publication; 静态 C／factory／配置／内存计划 resolved.json：单向审计投影 Static C / factory / config / memory plan resolved.json: one-way audit projection; 包内 CMake：唯一 C 源码目标图 Package CMake: the sole C source target graph; Ninja：编译、链接与资源检查 Ninja: compilation, linking and resource checks; 本次 ELF／BIN／map／资源报告 This execution: ELF / BIN / map / resource reports; 输入、解析、生成或发布失败 Input, resolution, generation or publication failure; 仅使拥有的 bundle 失效 不继续使用旧输出或半成品 Invalidate only the owned bundle Do not reuse stale or partial output; 唯一装配入口 Sole assembly input; 显式所选文件 Explicit selected files; 声明的事实 Declared facts; 授权条件 Authorization conditions; 同一代 binding 与事实 Bindings and facts from one generation; 精确器件与 Board 事实 Exact device and Board facts; 冻结用户选择 Frozen user selections; 已维护政策 Maintained policies; 验证通过 Validated; 具名字段与固定引用 Named fields and fixed references; 所选 recipe／fragments Selected recipes / fragments; 生成静态连接 C Render static connection C; 单向配置与审计投影 One-way configuration and audit projections; 成功发布 Successful publication; 生成配置与源 Generated configuration and sources; 仅选择构建入口；不另列 .c 图 Select build entry; no second .c graph; 执行唯一目标图 Execute the sole target graph; 实际产物 Actual artifacts; 非法字段 Invalid fields; 非法或变化的输入 Invalid or changed input; 非法模式或冲突 Invalid mode or conflict; 非法静态连接 Invalid static connection; 生成或发布失败 Generation or publication failure; 清理本次拥有的输出 Invalidate this attempt's owned output
